observed_mechanisms.behavior: Selects status == unlinked_requires_trace or deferred; linked non-deferred candidates are excluded even if only part of their claim survived.
observed_mechanisms.evidence_code: candidates = [c for c in coverage['candidates'] if c['status'] == 'unlinked_requires_trace' or c.get('deferred')]

observed_mechanisms.behavior: Standard findings merge user message is built from 02_text_analysis.json and 01_blocks_analysis.json; the primary TEXT addition tested in the pilot is not present in this message construction.
observed_mechanisms.scope: Inspected prompt construction; not a claim about every provider tool capability.

observed_mechanisms.behavior: Validates candidate action, reason, references and final links; semantic_verified remains False. No atomic subclaim completion check.

planned_changes.behavior: Require explicit independently checkable subclaims with stable IDs, source requirements, output links and dispositions; retained candidate is not equivalent to all subclaims verified. Preserve primary TEXT verbatim and identify absent images explicitly.

Include unresolved subclaims of linked candidates; pass existing confirmed finding as context and request only missing evidence operations. Do not regenerate already confirmed content as another issue.
Retain unresolved obligations until an explicit addressed outcome supersedes each one. A later candidate-level receipt must not silently erase pending subclaims.
Merge verified subclaims back into their finding, retain unresolved material in questions where appropriate, preserve traceability and report both candidate and atomic coverage.
